title: Jason W NDE 9206
content: I was thrust into a black void that felt really good. I had no body, no sense of touch, nor smell or taste. But, I could somehow feel an intense peaceful, joyful feeling in an endless black void. When I thought, 'Well this is nice, but I'm not ready yet.' Then, I thought of my parents. I came back to my body and was then breathing again, in the real world. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 10/20/2013 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Direct head injury. I was assaulted while skiing, and then confirmed dead by witnesses How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? Uncertain. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I was in a void and couldn't see. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I was in a void and didn't hear. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? context.nde_cause_other_detail: Assault while skiing; direct head injury.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Black void with intense peace/joy; no tunnel, no light, no beings.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Immediate entry into a pleasant black void; thought 'I'm not ready yet' and thought of parents; returned to body and began breathing again.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Pleasant black void with no sensory perception (no sight/hearing/touch/smell/taste) but intense peace/joy; return appeared to follow the thought 'I'm not ready yet' and thinking of parents.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was thrust into a black void that felt really good.”; “Well this is nice, but I'm not ready yet.”
